conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.query: { e: fetch cloud_run_revision :: logging.googleapis.com/user/mcp_request_errors | align rate(5m) ; t: fetch cloud_run_revision :: logging.googleapis.com/user/mcp_requests_total | align rate(5m) } | join | value [ratio: val(0) / val(1)] | condition ratio > 0.01

documentation.content: The /mcp request error rate (5xx responses divided by total completed requests) exceeded 1% over a 5-minute window. v1 default threshold. The MQL ratio query is verified and tuned at apply time (see observability/README.md).
